description: Wire Vertex AI as a chat provider in router.py's generate_response() and stream_response() functions, and add a unit test to verify routing logic.
steps: In apps/backend/app/services/ai/router.py, modify generate_response() to add a Vertex model detection branch BEFORE the Cloudflare fallback. Match on 'gemini' or 'vertex' in model.lower(). When matched, lazily import generate_with_vertex from app.services.ai.vertex_client and call it with system_prompt, user_message, model, and stream parameters.

In apps/backend/app/services/ai/router.py, modify stream_response() to add a Vertex model detection branch BEFORE the Cloudflare fallback else clause. Match on 'gemini' or 'vertex' in model.lower(). When matched, lazily import vertex_client from app.services.ai.vertex_client and use vertex_client.stream_generate_with_retry(system_prompt, user_message) for streaming with retry, following the same pattern as the Sarvam branch. Log routing with logger.info.

Create a new test file apps/backend/tests/test_ai_router.py that tests the routing logic. Use pytest with unittest.mock to mock the vertex_client, sarvam_client, and cloudflare_client modules. Test cases: (1) generate_response with model='gemini-1.5-pro' routes to vertex, (2) generate_response with model='openhathi-7b' routes to sarvam, (3) generate_response with model='@cf/meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct' routes to cloudflare, (4) stream_response with model='gemini-1.5-pro' routes to vertex streaming, (5) stream_response with model containing 'sarvam' routes to sarvam streaming. Follow the pytest-asyncio patterns from conftest.py (use @pytest.mark.anyio).
acceptance_criteria: router.py generate_response() routes models containing 'gemini' or 'vertex' to the Vertex AI client
router.py stream_response() routes models containing 'gemini' or 'vertex' to the Vertex AI streaming client with retry
Cloudflare remains the default fallback for models that don't match Sarvam or Vertex patterns
New test file test_ai_router.py passes with all routing scenarios covered
Running pytest tests/ from apps/backend passes with no failures
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_ai_router.py -v to confirm new tests pass
Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q to confirm no regressions
findings: All 5 new routing tests pass. Pre-existing test failures in test_chat.py and test_admin_endpoints.py are due to missing sentry_sdk package in the environment, confirmed unrelated to this change. JWT_SECRET env var required for tests (min 32 chars).
